evidence.quote: the first element as 40.55 and the latter is only 30... JSON will interpret the former as Double and the latter as Integer, creating the schema conflict"; reporter: "ah, how dumb I am.

notes: Outbox JSON expansion infers the schema from the first array element. Inconsistent numeric literals in the payload caused the conflict; the EventRouter's schema-inference code settles it.

reviews.fix: Write consistent JSON numeric types in the outbox payload (e.g. 30.0 instead of 30) so schema inference does not conflict.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "If both are written as "40.55" and "30.0" respectively, you shouldn't see an issue." Fatih Küçük: "ah, how dumb I am. Thanks Chris."

reviews.fix: Write outbox JSON payloads with consistent numeric types (e.g. 30.0 instead of 30) so JSON expansion infers one schema.
